packageRules.description: Held at 0.51.3 in go.mod on purpose: from 0.52.0 the github.com/bazelbuild packages are shims re-exporting github.com/bazel-contrib/bazel-gazelle/v2, which does not yet publish config, resolve, language or repo, so `go mod tidy` cannot resolve them. Bazel builds //tools/*/gazelle against @gazelle sources and is unaffected. Re-enable once upstream publishes a complete v2.
Distroless images are digest pins on floating tags rebuilt continuously upstream — no versioned releases exist to render a changelog from. Link the source and say so in the PR body instead.
prBodyNotes: **No changelog available**: distroless publishes digest-pinned floating tags with no versioned releases, so this digest cannot be mapped to release notes. Recent upstream changes: https://github.com/GoogleContainerTools/distroless/commits/main
